title: Permutation invariance of the quadratic bit
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $\pi$ be a permutation of the $n$ coordinates. The complete quadratic bit of the vector whose coordinate $i$ is $x_{\pi(i)}$ equals the complete quadratic bit of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a permutation of the coordinates
